factProposals.value: Reviewers work from three web pages served by the FastAPI app: the Review Queue (/queue/), the per-review findings page (/reviewer/) and a Rules page (/rules/) listing every active Stress Test rule with a fictional passing and failing example.

A review moves Pending -> In Review (first reviewer decision) -> Feedback Generated (final feedback prepared and locked) -> Completed (Basecamp confirmed the post). The page works this out from the reviewer action log, the prepared feedback and the posting records.

Every reviewer page load is written to the audit trail with the reviewer id and a UTC timestamp (queue_viewed, review_detail_viewed, rules_viewed), including refused and failed loads; a page is not shown if its audit record cannot be written.
Reviewers need to see what each Stress Test rule means with an example; the rule files now carry an optional example that is shown to reviewers and never sent to Claude.

decisions.statement: Show a status worked out from existing records instead of adding status updates to the Review Queue store.
decisions.rationale: user decision 2026-09-30: keeps STORY-001's queue store unchanged; the stored item stays Pending until a post succeeds

decisions.statement: No 'Post to Basecamp' button until Basecamp sign-in exists; the page says the feedback waits as Feedback Generated.
decisions.rationale: user decision 2026-09-30: real posting is off until STORY-014, so a button would always be refused

decisions.statement: Headings say 'Stress Test 0' rather than the code 'ST0'; rule ids such as ST0-002 stay as codes.
Rule examples are fictional and display-only: the evaluation prompt never includes them.
decisions.rationale: the repo is public (no student work), and examples must not change evaluations or their cost

decisions.statement: Reviewer pages are served with Cache-Control: no-cache.
decisions.rationale: a browser reused an old shared stylesheet and script with a new page, leaving the header unstyled and the queue empty

limitations.statement: The Review Queue is held in memory, so after a server restart the queue page is empty until intake runs again (reviewer decisions on disk are kept).
Reviewer identity on every page is still the unverified X-Reviewer-Id header until Basecamp sign-in (STORY-014).
If a comment is re-evaluated under newer rules after a reviewer acted, that review's detail is refused (REVIEW_STATE_MISMATCH) rather than guessed.
Page layout has no automated browser test; it was checked by eye by the project owner.
